fluff.overview:
The Nexus II represents the Word of Blake's fulfillment of a long-promised comprehensive overhaul of the Nexus platform. Produced by Blakist engineers at Skobel MechWorks on Terra beginning in 3066, the Nexus II addressed virtually every criticism of the original, creating a substantially more capable combat platform with improved armor, greater speed, and extended jump capability.

Production of the Nexus II remained confined to the Terra facility under Word of Blake control throughout the Jihad. Following the Blakist defeat, the production line fell silent, though the design's influence extended beyond its own production run. Recovered blueprints would eventually enable the Scorpion Empire to develop the Star Python, a fully Clan-tech derivative, in 3152.
fluff.capabilities:
The Nexus II addresses virtually every criticism leveled at its predecessor through aggressive application of advanced technology. The Vox-LE 200 light fusion engine increases top speed to approximately 130 kilometers per hour while providing better survivability than an extralight design. Six Rawlings 55 jump jets enable an impressive 180-meter jump capability, making the Nexus II one of the most mobile light 'Mechs of its era.

The weapons suite shifts entirely to extended-range energy weapons, with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER medium lasers and two ER small lasers providing effective firepower at longer ranges than the original Nexus's close-quarters loadout. An integrated C3i computer maintains the cooperative targeting capability that defines the Nexus line. Armor protection increases to three and a half tons of Krupp 200 standard plating, nearly doubling the coverage of the original, though the switch from ferro-fibrous to standard armor means this improvement comes at a significant weight cost.

The proven Skobel 100-ROB endo-steel chassis carries forward from the original Jackrabbit design, providing a reliable structural foundation that has now served across three generations of 'Mechs. Ten double heat sinks manage the all-energy arsenal efficiently, allowing sustained fire without excessive heat buildup.
fluff.history:
The Nexus II was born from necessity and frustration. Throughout the late 3050s, Nexus pilots had complained bitterly about the design's inadequate armor and short-range weapons, problems that Operation Odysseus in 3058 made impossible to ignore. When the Word of Blake seized control of Terra and the Skobel MechWorks facility, Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais inherited both the production line and the backlog of pilot grievances. He promised a comprehensive overhaul when resources permitted.

The breakthrough came through diplomatic channels. Technology exchange agreements with Archon-Princess Katherine Steiner-Davion provided access to the Lyran Alliance's light fusion engine technology, solving the fundamental weight problem that had constrained the original Nexus design. Given the 'Mech's limited internal space, Blakist engineers chose to redesign the Nexus from the ground up rather than risk compromising the existing chassis integrity. The extensively modified Nexus II began production in 3066, entering service with the Word of Blake Militia just as the Jihad erupted.

Both the NXS2-A and the electronic warfare-focused NXS2-B served exclusively within Word of Blake formations throughout the Jihad. The Third Division, which had suffered heavily with the original Nexus, was among the first units to receive the upgraded design and quickly validated its improved combat performance. Production ceased with the fall of the Word of Blake Protectorate, and the Skobel facility on Terra passed to the Republic of the Sphere.

While no new Nexus II production has been confirmed since the Jihad, the design's legacy endured through unexpected channels. Damaged Word of Blake blueprints preserved in Hanseatic League archives on Braunschweig were recovered by the Scorpion Empire, which used them to develop the Star Python, a fully Clan-tech derivative that entered production in 3152 with Imperial BattleMechs. The Star Python's adoption by the former Clan Goliath Scorpion is a startling degree of pragmatism, as the design's lineage stretches back through the Blakist Nexus II and ComStar Nexus to the Rim Worlds Republic's despised Jackrabbit. The Scorpion Empire's willingness to embrace such a tainted heritage speaks to the removal of many traditional Clan stigmas under the pressure of external threats from the Clan Homeworlds.
fluff.deployment: The sole known electronic warfare variant of the Nexus II, the -2B sacrifices all six jump jets and its small lasers to mount an extensive sensor and countermeasure suite. A Guardian ECM system, Beagle active probe, and TAG target designation gear transform the chassis into a dedicated reconnaissance and electronic warfare platform. Stealth armor further enhances the design's scouting profile, making it exceptionally difficult to detect and engage at range. Only one example of this variant is currently confirmed to exist, trading the -2A's versatile mobility for specialized electronic warfare capability.
